identity.name: Archax: Fidelity Institutional Liquidity Fund - The United States Dollar Fund (A-FLEX-DIST)

about.description: A beneficial-ownership token issued by FCA-regulated digital asset exchange and custodian Archax, representing units of the Fidelity Institutional Liquidity Fund - The United States Dollar Fund (A-FLEX-DIST) held in Archax custody. Tokens are issued on Hedera, are KYC-gated to onboarded professional clients, and track $1 distributing fund units one-to-one.
about.registryInfo: Beneficial-ownership token issued by Archax Ltd (FCA-regulated digital securities exchange, brokerage and custodian): Archax purchases units of the underlying institutional money market fund via its nominee and issues tokens 1:1 against custodied fund units on Hedera (KYC key set; whitelist-gated transfers), with small XDC side deployments. Only onboarded professional Archax clients can hold or transfer.
